name: Tests

on:
  push:
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 10 * * 0'

env:
  CHROME_BUILD_NUMBER: 131.0.6778.85

jobs:
  test:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        # https://github.com/federicocarboni/setup-ffmpeg/issues/21
        # TODO linux arm64 when available https://github.com/orgs/community/discussions/19197
        os: [macos-26, macos-26-intel, ubuntu-24.04, windows-2025]

    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}

    steps:
      # Windows fix. See https://github.com/actions/checkout/issues/226
      - run: git config --global core.autocrlf false

      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: true

      - name: Get yarn cache directory path
        id: yarn-cache-dir-path
        run: echo "::set-output name=dir::$(yarn config get cacheFolder)"

      - name: Cache browser
        id: cache-browser
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: browser
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-browser-${{ env.CHROME_BUILD_NUMBER }}

      # https://github.com/federicocarboni/setup-ffmpeg/issues/21
      - if: runner.os != 'macOS' || runner.arch != 'ARM64'
        uses: FedericoCarboni/setup-ffmpeg@v3
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      - if: runner.os == 'macOS' && runner.arch == 'ARM64'
        run: brew install ffmpeg

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: 'yarn'

      - run: npx @puppeteer/browsers install chrome@${{ env.CHROME_BUILD_NUMBER }} --path ${{ github.workspace }}/browser
  
      - run: yarn install --immutable
      - run: yarn dedupe --check
      - run: yarn tsc

      - name: CPU and memory
        run: node --experimental-default-type module -e 'import os from "os"; console.log("CPUs:", os.cpus().length, "mem:", (os.freemem()/1e9).toFixed(1), "/", (os.totalmem()/1e9).toFixed(1), "GB");'

      - run: yarn test:e2e
      - run: yarn lint

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: failure()
        with:
          name: artifact
          path: |
            reactive-video-assets/test-output/
            reactive-video-assets/test-image-snapshots/__diff_output__/

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
